items.title: 7.4.1 Applications of Combination in Real Life (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein humne combination ka formula \({}^{n}C_{r} = \dfrac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\) seekha. Ab dekhte hain ke yeh roz marra zindagi mein kahan kaam aata hai. Jab bhi hum bohat si cheezon mein se kuch chunte hain aur tarteeb ki parwah nahin karte, wahan combination lagta hai: chart ke liye phal, team ke liye players, imtihan mein attempt karne ke liye sawal, pizza ke flavours. Is sabaq mein kitab ki do misaalein qadam ba qadam hal karte hain. Har sawal mein hum pehle yeh tay karenge ke order matter karta hai ya nahin, phir \(n\) aur \(r\) pehchanenge, aur aakhir mein jawab ki tasdeeq karenge. Yahi teen qadam aap ko har combination wale sawal mein kaam denge, chahe sawal kitna hi lamba kyun na ho.

blocks.title: Example 9
blocks.problem: Zain has 8 different fruits. He wants to select 5 fruits out of 8 fruits to make a fruit chart. How many combinations of fruits he can select?
steps:
Given: 8 mukhtalif phal hain; in mein se 5 chunne hain.
To find: 5 phalon ke kitne mukhtalif chunao ho sakte hain.
Method: sab se pehle sawal yeh hai ke order matter karta hai ya nahin. Chart par kaun se phal lagne hain, bas yahi ahem hai; seb pehle chuna ya aam, is se chart nahin badalta. Is liye yeh combination hai, \(n = 8\) aur \(r = 5\).

Step 1: Formula likhein aur values rakhein
\[{}^{n}C_{r} = \dfrac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\]
\[{}^{8}C_{5} = \dfrac{8!}{5!\,(8-5)!} = \dfrac{8!}{5!\,3!}\]
Kyun: kul phal \(n = 8\) hain aur chunne wale \(r = 5\). Pehle formula likh dena achhi aadat hai; examiner ko pata chalta hai ke aap ne sahi formula chuna.

Step 2: \(8!\) ko \(5!\) tak kholein aur kaatein
\[= \dfrac{8 \times 7 \times 6 \times 5!}{5!\;3!}\]
\[= \dfrac{8 \times 7 \times 6}{3 \times 2 \times 1}\]
Kyun: \(8! = 8 \times 7 \times 6 \times 5!\) likh sakte hain, kyun ke \(5! = 5 \times 4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1\) us ka baqi hissa hai. Upar aur neeche \(5!\) kat jata hai, aur hum \(40320\) jaise bare numbers se bach jate hain.

Step 3: Hal karein
\[= 8 \times 7 = 56 \text{ ways}\]
Kyun: neeche \(3 \times 2 \times 1 = 6\) hai jo upar wale 6 ko kaat deta hai. Bacha \(8 \times 7 = 56\).

Tasdeeq:
5 phal chart par lagane ke liye chunna aur 3 phal bahar chhorne ke liye chunna aik hi baat hai. Is liye \({}^{8}C_{3} = \frac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 56\) bhi aana chahiye, aur wohi aaya. Yeh idea aap agle sabaq 7.4.2 mein theorem ki shakal mein parhenge.
blocks.answer: Zain 5 mukhtalif phal 56 mukhtalif tareeqon se chun sakta hai.

blocks.title: Example 10
blocks.problem: In a school, a class consists of 12 girls and 8 boys. The teacher wants to select 5 students for an activity. In how many ways can the students be selected including? (i) 2 girls (ii) 5 boys (iii) 2 boys
steps:
Given: class mein 12 larkiyan aur 8 larke hain; activity ke liye 5 students chunne hain.
To find: kitne tareeqe hain jab group mein (i) theek 2 larkiyan, (ii) theek 5 larke, (iii) theek 2 larke hon.
Method: activity ka group aik chunao hai, order ki koi ahmiyat nahin, is liye combination. Jab group mein do qisam ke log hon (larkiyan aur larke), to har qisam ko alag se chunte hain aur phir zarb karte hain (fundamental principle of counting).

Step 1 (i): Theek 2 larkiyan
5 ke group mein 2 larkiyan hon to baqi 3 jagahein larkon ki hain.
\[({}^{12}C_{2})({}^{8}C_{3}) = \dfrac{12!}{2!\,10!} \cdot \dfrac{8!}{3!\,5!}\]
\[= \dfrac{12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10!}{2 \cdot 10!} \cdot \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5!}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 \cdot 5!}\]
\[= 66 \times 56 = 3696\]
Kyun: 12 larkiyon mein se 2 chunne ke \({}^{12}C_{2} = 66\) tareeqe hain, aur 8 larkon mein se 3 chunne ke \({}^{8}C_{3} = 56\) tareeqe. Larkiyon ka har chunao larkon ke har chunao ke saath ban sakta hai, is liye zarb karte hain, jama nahin.

Step 2 (ii): Theek 5 larke
Saare 5 students larke hain, jo 8 larkon mein se chune jayenge.
\[{}^{8}C_{5} = \dfrac{8!}{5!\,(8-5)!} = \dfrac{8!}{5!\,3!}\]
\[= \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5!}{5! \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 56\]
Kyun: koi larki nahin chuni ja rahi, aur \({}^{12}C_{0} = 1\) hai, is liye sirf larkon ka chunao ginti mein aata hai. Yeh Example 9 jaisa hi hisaab hai.

Step 3 (iii): Theek 2 larke
5 ke group mein 2 larke hon to baqi 3 larkiyan hongi.
\[({}^{8}C_{2})({}^{12}C_{3}) = \dfrac{8!}{2!\,6!} \cdot \dfrac{12!}{3!\,9!}\]
\[= \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6!}{2 \cdot 6!} \cdot \dfrac{12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10 \cdot 9!}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 \cdot 9!}\]
Ab har hissa alag alag hal karte hain:
\[{}^{8}C_{2} = \dfrac{8 \cdot 7}{2} = 28\]
\[{}^{12}C_{3} = \dfrac{12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10}{6} = 220\]
\[28 \times 220 = 6160\]
Kyun: 8 larkon mein se 2 aur 12 larkiyon mein se 3, phir zarb. Kitab yahan 36960 chhapti hai jo ghalat hai (neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhein). Har factor ko alag hal karne ka faida yeh hai ke aisi ghalti foran pakri jati hai.

Tasdeeq:
(i) mein larkon wala hissa \({}^{8}C_{3} = 56\) hai, jo (ii) ke jawab \({}^{8}C_{5}\) ke barabar hai, kyun ke 3 chunna aur 5 chhorna aik hi baat hai. (iii) mein \({}^{12}C_{3} = {}^{12}C_{9} = 220\). Computer se class ke saare 5 students wale groups gin kar bhi dekha gaya: 2 larkiyon wale groups theek 3696 aur 2 larkon wale theek 6160 hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 10(iii) mein kitab \(({}^{8}C_{2})({}^{12}C_{3}) = 36960\) chhapti hai. Sahi jawab \({}^{8}C_{2} \times {}^{12}C_{3} = 28 \times 220 = 6160\) hai. 36960 asal mein \(6 \times 6160\) hai, yani \(\frac{12!}{3!\,9!}\) mein neeche wala \(3! = 6\) taqseem karna reh gaya. Imtihan mein 6160 hi likhein.

blocks.title: Challenge!
blocks.text: Aik restaurant pizza ke 6 flavours deta hai. 2 flavours chunne ke kitne tareeqe hain?

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Challenge ka hal: 2 flavours chunna aik chunao hai. Chicken fajita ke saath tikka, aur tikka ke saath chicken fajita, aik hi order hai, is liye order matter nahin karta:
\[{}^{6}C_{2} = \dfrac{6 \times 5}{2 \times 1} = 15\]
Yani 15 tareeqe. Agar aap ne \({}^{6}P_{2} = 30\) likha to har jori do dafa gin li.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari taraf se hai, kitab ka sawal nahin. Aik cricket club mein 7 batsmen aur 5 bowlers hain. 4 batsmen aur 2 bowlers ki 6 rukni committee kitne tareeqon se ban sakti hai?
\[{}^{7}C_{4} \times {}^{5}C_{2} = 35 \times 10 = 350\]
Kyun: batsmen aur bowlers alag alag chune jate hain aur phir dono chunao zarb hote hain, bilkul Example 10 ki tarah. Tasdeeq: upar ke numbers \(7 + 5 = 12\) club ke kul log, neeche \(4 + 2 = 6\) committee ke log.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: "Theek 2" (exactly 2) aur "kam az kam 2" (at least 2) mein bara farq hai. Is kitab ki Example 10 mein matlab theek 2 hai. Agar kabhi sawal "kam az kam 2 larkiyan" kahe, to aap ko 2, 3, 4 aur 5 larkiyon wale saare cases alag alag gin kar jama karne honge, kyun ke yeh aik doosre se alag (aapas mein na milne wale) cases hain. Yaad rakhiye: aik hi group ke andar hisse zarb hote hain, lekin alag alag cases jama hote hain. Yeh usool aap Exercise 7.4 ke sawalon mein bhi bar bar istemal karenge.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
1. Example 10 wali class mein se 5 students mein theek 3 larkiyan hon to? (Jawab: \({}^{12}C_{3} \times {}^{8}C_{2} = 220 \times 28 = 6160\). Dekhiye, yeh (iii) wala hi jawab hai, kyun ke 3 larkiyan matlab 2 larke.)
2. 10 kitabon mein se 4 safar par le jani hon to kitne tareeqe? (Jawab: \({}^{10}C_{4} = 210\).)

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Is kitab mein "including 2 girls" ka matlab hai theek 2 larkiyan, baqi larke. Sab se pehle split likhein, jaise "2 larkiyan + 3 larke", phir har hisse ka aik \({}^{n}C_{r}\) likh kar zarb karein. Aasan tasdeeq: upar wale numbers ka jama poori class (\(12 + 8 = 20\)) aur neeche wale numbers ka jama group (\(2 + 3 = 5\)) hona chahiye. Is se pata chal jata hai ke koi hissa reh to nahin gaya.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Bari tadaad mein se group chunna, jahan order matter na kare: \({}^{n}C_{r}\).
2. Do qisam ke log hon (larkiyan aur larke) to har qisam alag chunein aur zarb karein.
3. \({}^{n}C_{r} = {}^{n}C_{n-r}\): 5 rakhna aur 3 chhorna aik hi chunao hai.
4. Bare factorial ko pehle kaatein, phir zarb karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Zarb ki jagah jama karna: \({}^{12}C_{2} + {}^{8}C_{3}\) ghalat hai. Larkiyan AUR larke dono saath chune ja rahe hain, is liye zarb.
2. Doosri qisam bhool jana: 5 ke group mein "2 larkiyan" ho to baqi 3 jagahein larkon se bharna zaroori hai; sirf \({}^{12}C_{2}\) likh dena adhoora jawab hai.
3. Poora \(r!\) taqseem na karna: bilkul yahi ghalti 6160 ko 36960 bana deti hai.
4. Order wale sawal aur chunao wale sawal ko mila dena: pizza ke flavours, team, phal, yeh sab chunao hain.
